scenario_a_success.description: Full successful end-to-end appraisal workflow with parallel collection, verified evidence, and HoD approval.

reviewer.comments: All claims verified against institutional records. Recommended for promotion.

scenario_b_missing_evidence.description: Workflow with an unverified claim lacking supporting evidence reference.

scenario_c_mismatched_evidence.description: Workflow where claimed evidence certificate belongs to another faculty member (FAC002).

scenario_d_human_rejection.description: Workflow where reviewer exercises human oversight and rejects report for missing syllabus targets.

reviewer.comments: Teaching hours documentation does not meet minimum 120 contact hour requirement.

scenario_e_consent_denied.description: Workflow where faculty denies consent for Research Data Collection.

scenario_f_unauthorized_reviewer.description: Workflow where approval is attempted by an unauthorized role (Student).
